remarks: Discover a special Central Coast retreat at 135 Sharon Lane, offering 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, on approximately one-third of an acre in desirable Grover Beach Heights. Enjoy sweeping hillside scenery and ocean views from the wraparound deck, where coastal breezes and beautiful sunsets set the scene for relaxed California living. Inside, a cozy fireplace creates a welcoming atmosphere for cool coastal evenings. The versatile floor plan features three bedrooms and two bathrooms on the main level and a fourth bedroom and bath downstairs, offering flexibility for guests, extended family, a home office, or potential rental use.
